rules.statement: Parameters shall be declared as parameter logic [31:0] PARA_AFIFO_ with the three comment lines required by REF-003 PAR-02.
The RTL shall not include an elaboration check for illegal parameter values.
$clog2 may be used for the derived widths.
PARA_AFIFO_DEPTH (default 8) shall be a power of 2, minimum 2, with no upper limit; LPARA_ADDR_W and LPARA_PTR_W derive from it.
PARA_AFIFO_DATA_W (default 32) shall be at least 1, with no upper limit, and sets the width of i_wr_data, o_rd_data and storage.

PARA_AFIFO_CELL_TYPE (default 2) shall be 0..4 (0 bypass, 1 two series D flip-flops, 2 one 2-FF cell, 3 one 3-FF cell, 4 one 4-FF cell), with the same value on top, wr, rd, sync, cell_sync and both crossings.
Option 0 (bypass, no synchronization) shall not be used for the pointer crossings.
PARA_AFIFO_CELL_RST_VAL (default 0) shall be 0 for a flop with asynchronous reset to 0 or 1 for asynchronous set to 1, taken per synchronizer bit from PARA_AFIFO_SYNC_RST_VAL.
PARA_AFIFO_MEM_USE_MACRO (default 0) shall be 0 for an RTL array or 1 for the library SRAM wrapper, using the generic macro model until a real macro is mapped.
PARA_AFIFO_SYNC_W shall be 1 or more and is set by the parent to LPARA_PTR_W, giving the synchronizer width.
PARA_AFIFO_SYNC_RST_VAL (default 0) shall be a vector of PARA_AFIFO_SYNC_W bits giving one reset value per bit for every synchronizer stage.
PARA_AFIFO_SYNC_RST_VAL shall be a legal Gray pointer value, namely 0.
LPARA_ADDR_W shall be derived as log2 of PARA_AFIFO_DEPTH, and LPARA_PTR_W shall be derived as LPARA_ADDR_W + 1.
Illegal configurations (depth not a power of 2, depth below 2, stage count outside 2..4, option parameter outside 0..1) shall not be used.
The IP shall not check illegal configurations, and behavior with an illegal value is undefined.
